body:
WHERE THE FIX GOES, AND THE TRAPS (playback_engine.dart read in full, 6 Nov 2026, main 068c71a; only B-51's own proof was run). The task text stays the definition; this adds what the code shows.

ROOT. `_onCompleted` (playback_engine.dart:1292-1314) sets `_completedSerial` (1297) and returns early when it equals `_loadSerial` (1296), which changes only in `_loadCurrentBody` (1137). At the end of the queue (1306) the engine pauses and seeks to 0 but keeps `_loaded` with the cursor on the LAST song; `play()` (532) then only calls `_backend.play()` on the same load, its second end is ignored, nothing pauses.

DECIDED (advisor for the owner, yours to overrule): after a finished list, Play restarts it from the first song at every entry point (album page, mini player, lock screen, headset), same source and shuffle setting.

FIX IN THE ENGINE, not the album page (task text item 2 patches only that). Every Play reaches `PlaybackEngine.play()`/`togglePlayPause()`: detail_screens.dart:112, catalogue_screens.dart:378,530, imported_playlist_screen.dart:154, search_results.dart:350, now_playing_screen.dart:404, mini_player.dart:130 (tear-off), lyrics_screen.dart:268, the lock screen (encore_audio_handler.dart:301), Jam (jam_facade.dart:192-199).
 * Restart: an `_endedQueue` flag set at the end branch (1309); `play()` with it set jumps to index 0 and loads (a new load is a new serial). Clear it on any new load, skip, jump or queue edit.
 * The guard must change too: the person can drag the slider (or the lock screen's seek) and then press Play, back in the same load. Reset `_completedSerial` in the PUBLIC operations that resume it: `play()`, `seek()` (570), the restart branch of `skipPrevious` (626). The internal `_backend.seek` inside `_onCompleted` must not, which keeps it loop-proof.
 * Never "playing" while silent: `_build` (1500) copies `_backend.state.playing`, and the media session copies that (encore_audio_handler.dart:206). One guard (`playing && processing != completed`) fixes notification, lock screen and mini player together.

CHANGES A BUILT BEHAVIOUR: docs/33 PB-26 says "stays loaded and paused, ready to replay", pinned by 'end of queue with repeat off stops on the last track' (playback_engine_test.dart:381). Update PB-26's Play column in the same PR; the test keeps its half.

TRAPS
 1. Do not just delete the guard at 1296: its comment (1294) says pausing a finished player re-announces "completed", so pause -> completed -> `_onCompleted` -> pause loops.
 2. `FakeAudioBackend` (test/support/fake_audio_backend.dart:101-117) keeps `completed` through `seek` and `play`; the real just_audio leaves it after a seek. A fix keyed to "leaves completed" is invisible on the fake: model the real transition, or use the public operations above.
 3. The missing test: play to the end (`finishCurrent()`, 170), `play()`, end again: cursor at song 1, then paused with `isPlaying` false; three times (trap 1); and end, seek to the middle, Play, end: paused. Add the lock-screen path in audio_handler_test.dart.
 4. `togglePlayPause` (554) decides from `_backend.state.playing`, not the snapshot. A guard only in `_build` shows Play while the backend says playing, and the first tap calls `pause()`: nothing happens. Share one "is it sounding" check.

REPEAT: `play_after_end.py` (cited in B-51) is not in the repository; use the recipe in docs/evidence/README.md#d01 row B-51. The acceptance needs a real phone.
